exposure: stillbirth evaluations (placental pathology, fetal autopsy, fetal genetic testing, fetal bacterial cultures, viral testing)
outcome: adherence to American College of Obstetrics and Gynecology core stillbirth evaluation recommendations
prevalence and yield of specific testing for infection-attributable stillbirth etiologies
cohort: The study included 399 stillbirths from three university-affiliated perinatal centers between 2017 and 2022.
finding: Adherence to core stillbirth evaluation recommendations was poor, and infection testing was infrequent, which may lead to an underestimation of infection-attributable stillbirth prevalence.
